canonical_title: Arresting gear system and tire failure considerations

versions.title_at_revision: Arresting gear system and tire failure considerations
versions.text:
Standard: For air vehicles equipped with arresting gear, no part of the landing gear, air vehicle, or stores will snag the arresting cable for all air vehicle configurations when air vehicle is rolling on wheels with a flat tire. Minimum landing gear wheel diameter size is greater than six inches. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to verify cable rollover capability during tire failure and roll on wheel condition for all operational requirements and cable dynamics.
